# Druks

> AI agents work. You make the call. Druks runs Claude Code and Codex on your recurring engineering work, self-hosted or in the cloud, and asks a person before anything changes.

Druks is a platform where AI agents do a company's recurring engineering work, and a person approves each change.

- It finds the work. A schedule, an alert or a button starts a run. Nobody writes a prompt.
- It does the work with your tools: Claude Code or Codex, with your own Claude or OpenAI account, in a sandbox, on your real repositories. You see the cost after every step.
- You make the call. The run stops and asks: Approve, Change or Stop. You answer in Slack, the dashboard, the Druks chat or Claude Code.

The security sweep is the first app. Every week it reads a repository's open Dependabot alerts, checks which ones touch code you call, upgrades the packages in a sandbox, runs your tests, and opens a pull request only after you approve.

Druks is source available under the Functional Source License (FSL-1.1-ALv2). You can self-host it, change it and build apps on it. Each release becomes Apache 2.0 two years after it ships.

## Get started

- [Try Druks Cloud](https://app.druks.ai/sign-in?utm_source=llms.txt): We run Druks for you. You connect your repositories and approve.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.druks.ai/quickstart): From nothing to your first approval, on Druks Cloud or on your own machine.
- [Connect your agent](https://docs.druks.ai/connect-your-agent): Connect Claude Code or Codex to the Druks MCP endpoint.

- [Documentation index for LLMs](https://docs.druks.ai/llms.txt): Every docs page, with a one-line summary.
